company1.description: Frontend Developer with {{ years }} years of experience in Angular and TypeScript, working on the evolution of scalable ERP web systems. Experience in legacy system refactoring, REST API integration and multi-tenant solution implementation. Focus on performance, usability and code quality, with hands-on experience in AWS, Docker and CI/CD to support the development and deployment cycle.
company1.frontendDescription: I prototyped, implemented and refactored several screens in the legacy ERP system (white-label), adding value to the ERP and enabling new clients and revenue. I worked on the analysis and definition of architecture for strategic integrations, including ERP x Zoho CRM and ERP x Gupshup API (WhatsApp), enabling user management and messaging process automation.
company1.frontendDetail1: Development and evolution of ERP web applications with Angular, improving performance by up to 60%
company1.frontendDetail2: Experience with microfrontend architecture using Single-SPA for composition and decoupling of Angular applications
company1.frontendDetail3: Integration of Angular applications with REST APIs built in .NET and Spring Boot 3
company1.frontendDetail4: Configuration and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines with Docker on Azure DevOps, deploying to AWS (S3, CloudFront, Route 53, Lambda)
company1.frontendDetail5: Consistent practice of Code Reviews in the development process, following SOLID principles and Design Patterns, always ensuring code quality
company1.frontendDetail6: Led adoption of new tools and AI for development automation (e.g. ClaudeCode, ChatGPT), increasing team productivity by up to 70%
company1.backendDescription: On the backend, I maintained a report generation API, and among the updates I implemented was the ability to also export reports in XLSX and HTML. Users noticed greater integration with tools like Excel (XLSX) and the browser itself (HTML), as well as enabling interactive reports with drill-down visualization.
company1.backendDetail1: Development and evolution of ERP web system using Angular (microfrontends with Single-SPA) and REST APIs in Java (Spring Boot 3), improving application performance by approximately 50–60% after structural optimizations
company1.backendDetail2: Implementation and maintenance of reporting APIs with export to XLSX, CSV, HTML and PDF, expanding integration with external tools and improving user experience
company1.backendDetail3: Query and endpoint optimization in the backend (Java + MySQL and Oracle databases), enabling higher concurrent user volume and reducing resource consumption
company1.backendDetail4: Refactoring of Python scripts responsible for report versioning and storage, eliminating duplications and significantly reducing AWS S3 costs
company1.backendDetail5: Configuration and automation of CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Azure DevOps, deploying to AWS (S3, CloudFront, Route 53) and accelerating the delivery cycle
company1.backendDetail6: Continuously ran CRUD commands, FOR UPDATE, JOINS, etc. on Oracle DB to manage ERP menus
